question: Can you provide the number of distinct active and closed bike share stations for each year 2013 and 2014?
sql:
SELECT 
  year,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'active' THEN distinct_stations ELSE 0 END) as active_stations,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'closed' THEN distinct_stations ELSE 0 END) as closed_stations
FROM (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.start_time) as year,
    s.status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.station_id) as distinct_stations
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_stations` s ON s.station_id = t.start_station_id
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.start_time) IN (2013, 2014)
  GROUP BY year, s.status
)
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year
